t: How to get PQP towards your @united Premier status w/o flying: Buy any flight. Once you purchase, search for the option to “get more miles” with an Award accelerator under flight info. Once you click, it will give you the option to buy regular miles AND add PQP for an additional amount. Once you’ve done that, you cancel your flight w/in 24hrs. You’ll get a flight refund but the PQP can’t be refunded so it stays in your account & goes towards your premier status w/o you having to fly.
